event: West Java police raid an illegal-drug factory in the Bizpark complex in Kopo, Bandung, making tramadol and hexymer tablets, with an estimated capacity of 8 million tablets per day and five suspects named.
key_numbers: Capacity up to 8 million tablets/day (police estimate) · raw material could yield up to 256 million tablets · 600,000 ready tablets seized on first arrest (Fri 16 Oct, Purbaleunyi KM 125) bound for Jakarta · 5 suspects · raids 17-18 Oct · Kapolda Jabar Irjen Hengki

event: Free-meal (MBG) poisoning stays in the news: a student speaker cites more than 60,000 cases at the 2-year protests build-up, Bakom rejects a moratorium, and a Kompas report says E. coli was found on kitchen equipment at a Sukabumi SPPG.
key_numbers: Student claim: over 60,000 poisoning cases, losses near Rp30 miliar (no source given) · JPPI earlier counted 40,759 victims in 36 provinces (Kompas.id headline, date not confirmed) · Sukabumi SMKN 1 Gunungguruh: 151 teachers and students (9 Oct) · Konawe Selatan: 144 students · Bakom (Syahganda Nainggolan) opposes a moratorium · BGN head Sudaryono 'improving'
sources: tvOne (Bakom, students) <https://www.tvonenews.com/berita/nasional/473886-mahasiswa-soroti-kasus-keracunan-mbg-yang-terus-meningkat-bakom-ri-sebut-pembenahan-terus-dilakukan> ; Kompas Bandung (E. coli, headline) <https://bandung.kompas.com/read/2026/10/19/180000678/bakteri-e.-coli-ditemukan-di-peralatan-makan-sppg-sukabumi-diduga-penyebab> ; Detik (Sukabumi 151) <https://www.detik.com/jabar/berita/d-8697338/151-guru-dan-siswa-di-sukabumi-diduga-keracunan-mbg>

event: Cek Fakta: ANTARA and Liputan6 debunk three spreading hoaxes, a post that Prabowo will extend the MBG programme to Timor-Leste, a fake Jasa Marga job-vacancy link, and a free online SIM registration link. (update of E0116)
key_numbers: MBG-to-Timor-Leste: Threads post 8 Oct, no official statement; Prabowo-Ramos-Horta met 28 Aug 2026 · Jasa Marga vacancy: Instagram post 17 Oct, Rp7-12 juta salary lure, collects KTP name and Telegram number · SIM online link (Liputan6) · earlier hoaxes: MBG closure (E0116), Pertalite price · Komdigi (Angga Raka Prabowo, 18 Oct) denies that platforms restrict karhutla content
sources: ANTARA Anti Hoax <https://antaranews.com/berita/5797021/hoaks-prabowo-putuskan-program-mbg-disalurkan-ke-timor-leste-atas-permintaan-presiden-timor-leste> ; Liputan6 Cek Fakta (Jasa Marga) <https://www.liputan6.com/cek-fakta/read/8316308/cek-fakta-hoaks-link-pendaftaran-lowongan-kerja-jasa-marga-2026> ; Liputan6 Cek Fakta (SIM) <https://www.liputan6.com/cek-fakta/read/8316382/cek-fakta-hoaks-link-pendaftaran-dan-pembuatan-sim-online-gratis> ; Okezone (Komdigi on Instagram) <https://news.okezone.com/read/2026/10/18/337/3248648/komdigi-bantah-batasi-konten-karhutla-di-instagram>

event: KAI Commuter cancels seven Bogor-line KRL trips on 19 Oct because two train sets remain under repair by its engineers and PT INKA, adding to commuter complaints about repeated disruption.
key_numbers: 7 trips cancelled (1157, 1154, 1013A, 1014, 1124F, 1195F, 1192F) · 2 train sets under repair · earlier: 7 trips cancelled 16 Oct, one outlet says 10 trips · Kompas survey headline: Bogor-Jakarta passengers would pay more for fewer disruptions · RMOL: calls for INKA CEO to resign (opinion/political, not verified)

event: Four PSS Sleman supporters die in a toll-road accident at KM 616 Ngawi-Kertosono (Madiun) on the way to the Persebaya match; both teams hold a minute's silence before the 2-2 draw in Surabaya.
key_numbers: Sun 18 Oct 2026 · tol KM 616 Ngawi-Kertosono · 4 dead · match at Gelora Bung Tomo ended 2-2 · cause of accident not stated
